# sustain_alert_channel (Resource)

Somewhere alerts are sent beside email: a webhook, Slack, Discord, Teams, PagerDuty, Opsgenie or Telegram. Its address and key are sent, never kept; a webhook's signing secret is kept, sensitive.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "hook" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
  default   = "https://hooks.example.com/sustain"
}

# Its address is sent, never kept: raise url_wo_version to send it again. Its signing secret is kept, sensitive.
resource "sustain_alert_channel" "hook" {
  name           = "Ops webhook"
  kind           = "webhook"
  url            = var.hook
  url_wo_version = 1
  events         = ["incidents", "maintenance"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) A kind of alert channel: a webhook; a Slack, Discord or Teams channel; a PagerDuty service; an Opsgenie team; or a Telegram chat.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `chat_id` (String) A Telegram chat's id, or a public channel's @name.
- `events` (List of String) A webhook's: the events besides alerts it's sent too, incidents', maintenance's and monitors'; none for any other.
- `key` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) PagerDuty's or Opsgenie's integration key, or a Telegram bot's token.
- `key_wo_version` (Number) Raised to send `key` again, as Terraform keeps no write-only value to compare with.
- `region` (String) PagerDuty's or Opsgenie's account's region; us unless given.
- `url` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) A webhook's, Slack's, Discord's or Teams's address.
- `url_wo_version` (Number) Raised to send `url` again, as Terraform keeps no write-only value to compare with.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO 8601 time in UTC.
- `host` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) What a webhook's deliveries are signed with; only a webhook has one.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By its id in Sustain, as its page in the console, or its API, gives it.
terraform import sustain_alert_channel.hook <id>
```
